meta.title: Git Branch Cleaner - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Paste git branch output, check the branches to clean up, and generate git branch -d / -D and remote deletion cleanup scripts in one click.
desc: Paste git branch output, check the branches to clean up, and generate git branch -d / -D and remote deletion cleanup scripts in one click.
ui.1: git branch output (required, one branch per line, * marks the current branch)
ui.5: # Delete unmerged branches (-D force delete, confirm unmerged content first)
ui.100: Please check at least one branch to clean up
ui.102: git branch --merged output (optional, marks merged branches; leave blank to treat all as unmerged)
